function.name: PLAY_SONG
function.abstract: It starts the reproduction of music

description.p: It starts the reproduction of an archive of music recovered with the function . According to the type of archive, only it is possible to reproduce an archive of music at the same time, so that any music, which was playing, before it must stop by the function .
The second parameter indicates the number of times that must repeat the reproduction. It can be used 0 not to repeat it, or -1 to repeat all time until it is stopped by .
